_comment: Placeholder registry of MCP servers this harness WOULD connect to in production. The research_tools.py mocks stand in for these today. To go live: stand up (or point at) each MCP server, then replace the corresponding mock in research_tools.py with a Strands MCPClient that calls the server's tools. See https://strandsagents.com for MCP client wiring.

pubmed.description: Biomedical literature — PubMed / Europe PMC citations and abstracts.

ncbi-gene.description: Gene / variant / pathway lookup via NCBI Gene, Ensembl, UniProt.

chembl.description: Small-molecule bioactivity via ChEMBL / PubChem — targets, IC50/Ki, mechanism.

pdb-alphafold.description: Protein structure — RCSB PDB experimental structures and AlphaFold DB predictions.

lims.description: LIMS / screening / omics platform — assay results, plate maps, QC (Benchling, Genedata, or in-house).

clinicaltrials.description: Clinical-trial landscape via ClinicalTrials.gov / WHO ICTRP.

eln.description: Electronic Lab Notebook for draft entries (Benchling, LabArchives) — scientist signs and commits.
